title: Consultant
description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

**Your Impact:** OpenText is a world leader in Information Management, helping companies securely capture, govern and exchange information on a global scale. OpenText solves digital business challenges for Clients, ranging from small and mid\-sized businesses to the largest and most complex organizations in the world. That is high tech without the drama.
  
UCMDB Technical Consultant will provide technology consulting in the field of Infra Structure Discovery to external customers. Responsible for providing Implementation and Solution support to meet customers’ business needs and, consequently, for understanding customers’ businesses. Responsible for application administration and customization tasks for one or several highly complex customer cloud and off cloud deployments. A Technical Consultant possesses technical expertise in implementing, tuning and optimizing product solutions, adhering to Micro Focus (now Open text) best practices.
  
  

**What the role offers:**  

* UCMDB Technical Consultant will provide technology consulting in the field of Infra Structure Discovery to external customers. Responsible for providing Implementation and Solution support to meet customers’ business needs and, consequently, for understanding customers’ businesses.
* Responsible for application administration and customization tasks for one or several highly complex customer cloud and off cloud deployments.
* A Technical Consultant possesses technical expertise in implementing, tuning and optimizing product solutions, adhering to Micro Focus (now Open text) best practices.
* Experience in working with other members at remote location (International)
* Time flexibility for meetings that may be conducted outside local business hours
* Experience in working with Product Support and R for product related issues.
* Demonstrated technical documentation skills \- As\_build document, test plans, test results summary document etc.


**What you need to succeed:**  

* Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent degree in computer science or related area of study
* At least 3\-5 years Micro Focus/OpenText CMS products (UCMDB and UD) Implementation experience
* Good Infrastructure Knowledge
* Basic Networking concepts, DB Concepts and Server OS concepts.
* Has sufficient technical knowledge to assist with the completion of specific deliverables.
* Able to communicate concepts with team and Customer.
* Able to produce basic documentation to required standards.
* Demonstrates understanding of assigned discipline or technical area.
* Demonstrate fundamental technical knowledge.


**One last thing:**  

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.
  
  

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket atAsk HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

**1\. Business Development \& Client Support**

* Support the Director / Practice Lead in identifying, shaping, and progressing business development opportunities across Risk Advisory.
* Attend client meetings, workshops, and discovery sessions; capture key discussion points, client pain points, decisions, risks, and next steps.
* Convert client conversations into clear problem statements, solution themes, action plans, proposals, and follow\-up materials.

* Support pipeline tracking, opportunity qualification, revenue forecasting, proposal governance, and bid management.
* Work with internal SMEs, delivery leads, offshore teams, and solution teams to shape practical and commercially viable solutions.

### **2\. Chief of Staff Support to Practice Lead**

* Act as a trusted execution partner to the Risk Advisory leadership team.
* Track key priorities across revenue, pipeline, hiring, delivery, finance, team utilisation, capability building, and internal initiatives.
* Prepare leadership dashboards, weekly updates, action trackers, revenue views, and management reports.
* Coordinate with Finance, HR, Recruitment, Delivery, and Operations teams to ensure smooth practice management.
* Support internal governance meetings, leadership reviews, account planning sessions, and business performance reviews.
* Maintain a single view of key initiatives, risks, dependencies, decisions, and escalations.
* Help drive discipline around follow\-through, documentation, and timely execution.

### **3\. Risk Advisory Solutioning**

* Support solution development across areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory change, governance, controls, compliance transformation, operational risk, financial crime, data governance, process transformation, and reporting automation.
* Translate client challenges into structured consulting responses, operating model options, delivery plans, and benefits cases.
* Work with SMEs to develop industry\-relevant points of view, thought leadership, benchmarking insights, and reusable solution assets.
* Support the creation of accelerators, playbooks, capability decks, credentials, and case studies for the Risk Advisory practice.
* Bring structured thinking to ambiguous problems and help convert them into practical, executable solutions.

### **4\. Delivery Mobilisation \& Execution Support**

* Support mobilisation of new engagements by coordinating scope, deliverables, staffing, timelines, governance, and commercials.
* Work with delivery teams to ensure client commitments are clearly understood and tracked.
* Support preparation of project initiation materials, status packs, RAID logs, governance packs, and client updates.
* Help identify delivery risks, resource gaps, dependency issues, and escalation points.
* Ensure lessons learned, case studies, and delivery credentials are captured for future business development.

### **5\. Hiring, Team Development \& Capability Building**

* Coordinate with hiring teams to track open roles, candidate pipeline, interview progress, onboarding, and skill requirements.
* Help define role requirements for consultants, business analysts, SMEs, PMOs, and delivery support roles.
* Support capability building initiatives such as training plans, knowledge\-sharing sessions, communities of practice, and reusable content libraries.
* Maintain skill matrices, team capacity views, and capability trackers across the Risk Advisory team.
* Support onboarding of new joiners by creating role\-specific context packs and delivery/project
